title: Bun URL shortener
context: URL shortener on Bun.serve and bun:sqlite. Short codes must be unguessable. Only http: and https: targets may be stored (allowlist). expires_at is stored as Unix seconds; expired links return 410. ttlDays is 1-365.
code: db.run("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS links (code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, target TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, hits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)");
const insert = db.query("INSERT INTO links (code, target, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
const lookup = db.query("SELECT target, expires_at FROM links WHERE code = ?");
const bump = db.query("UPDATE links SET hits = hits + 1 WHERE code = ?");
for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) out += ALPHABET[Math.floor(Math.random() * ALPHABET.length)];
if (!Number.isInteger(ttlDays) || ttlDays < 1 || ttlDays > 365) return new Response("bad ttl", { status: 400 });
try { parsed = new URL(target); } catch { return new Response("bad url", { status: 400 }); }
if (parsed.protocol === "javascript:") return new Response("bad scheme", { status: 400 });
const row = lookup.get(code) as { target: string; expires_at: number } | null;
if (!row) return new Response("not found", { status: 404 });
if (row.expires_at < Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) return new Response("gone", { status: 410 });

expected.why: Math.random is not a CSPRNG, so short codes are predictable; use crypto.getRandomValues
blocklists one scheme instead of allowing only http:/https:, so data:, file: and vbscript: targets are accepted
expires_at is Unix seconds but Date.now() is milliseconds, so links effectively never expire
